name: GIN-Dock-Wallpaper
description: Unified Smart Hot-Corner Dock Bar & 4K Wallpaper Calendar HUD Engine for Windows 10/11
author: GinCz / Vladimir Bulantsev & Antigravity
features: Zero-Browser In-App Auto-Updater: downloads setup directly to %TEMP%, prompts confirmation, executes installer and restarts without opening browser
GIN-VPN Header Bar: Day (☼), Evening (☁), Night (☾) toggle buttons, Language (EN, RU, CS) buttons, and Audio toggle (♪) button
Dock Placement Buttons: stylish Top and Left buttons instead of dropdown list
Theme Selector Buttons: 10 curated themes in a responsive grid with instant real-time UI styling
Wallpaper Interval Buttons: 1 hour, 3 hours, 6 hours, 24 hours quick switch buttons
12 Font Preview Buttons: each button rendered in its own font with live real-time UI font application
Real Dock Icon Sizing: 16px, 24px, 32px, 48px, 64px button toggles with actual icon & geometry scaling
GIN-VPN Signature Footer: bottom-right clean gold VladiMIR+AI ||| v035 without underline
